qualitative.gate_2_reason: Non-essential / easily forgone product or service.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Rejected – G2 Essential Need). Logitech designs computer peripherals (mice, keyboards, webcams, gaming accessories). While high-quality and asset-light, PC peripherals represent deferrable, non-essential consumer hardware with multi-year replacement cycles, exhibiting severe post-pandemic cyclical contraction with zero deprivation pain.
qualitative.evidence: Global market leader in PC peripherals and gaming accessories with ~$4.3B in net sales in FY2024. Revenue surged during the 2020-2021 WFH boom before declining sharply by ~15-20% in FY2023 and an additional 5% in FY2024 as consumers and enterprise IT channels worked through inventory. Hardware upgrades are easily deferred for years, failing Munger's non-discretionary essential everyday habit standard.
